routes.name: Leidimas laikinai gyventi (darbas pagal darbo sutartį)

note: Lithuania, read on 2026-10-30 on the Migration Department's own service pages (MIGRIS, migracija.lt, rendered in a browser since they are drawn by script): the temporary residence permit for work under an employment contract, and the permanent residence permit for one who has lived in Lithuania five years without a break. A third-country national intending to work under an employment contract may get a temporary residence permit, within the year's quota: the inviting employer first files a letter of intermediation (committing to employ for at least 6 months full time), then the person applies through MIGRIS. The state fee is EUR 220 with a decision within 3 months (EUR 440 within 45 days if urgent; the ordinary kept). 'During the temporary residence permit you may work only for the employer who undertook to employ you' (work for the sponsor); a change of employer needs a new letter and an application to change the permit, not before 6 months. The permit is issued or changed (renewed, 'keitimas', asked between 6 months and one working day before it ends: renewable) for the period of work 'but not longer than 2 years', a ceiling and not a fixed term, so no term is kept. The page speaks of applying in Lithuania at the Department by appointment, and from 1 November 2026 only in listed cases (a valid permit or a Lithuanian national visa, among others); it doesn't say plainly where others apply, so where to apply is left out. Permanent residence may be asked after five years' continuous residence in Lithuania on a temporary residence permit (absences at most 6 months at a stretch and 10 in all; 5 kept as the work permit's years to it), with the Lithuanian language and Constitution exams and means of one minimum monthly wage a month for a year; the person applies in person at the Department's territorial division (in country), EUR 220 within 3 months. What work permanent residence allows isn't stated on its page and isn't written. EU citizens' registration of residence (free movement) wasn't read and isn't written. Naturalisation isn't read here.

sources.title: Migracijos departamentas (MIGRIS), Leidimas laikinai gyventi: Darbas pagal darbo sutartį
sources.said: Jūs galite gauti leidimą laikinai gyventi, jeigu Lietuvoje ketinate dirbti pagal darbo sutartį. ... Pirmiausia Jus kviečiantis darbdavys per MIGRIS turi pateikti tarpininkavimo raštą, pagal kurį jūs pildysite prašymą. ... per 3 mėnesius ... 220,00 Eur ... Leidimo laikinai gyventi metu galite dirbti tik pas tą darbdavį, kuris įsipareigojo jus įdarbinti. ... Prašymas pakeisti leidimą laikinai gyventi ir prie jo pridedami dokumentai pateikiami likus ne mažiau kaip 1 darbo dienai iki leidimo laikinai gyventi galiojimo pabaigos, bet ne anksčiau kaip prieš 6 mėnesius. ... Leidimas laikinai gyventi jums bus išduotas ar pakeistas darbo Lietuvos Respublikoje laikotarpiui, bet ne ilgiau kaip 2 metams. ... Jei prašymą teikiate Lietuvoje, atvykus rezervuotu vizito laiku į Migracijos departamentą, jūsų buvimas Lietuvoje turi būti teisėtas.

sources.title: Migracijos departamentas (MIGRIS), Leidimas nuolat gyventi: pragyvenau Lietuvoje be pertraukos pastaruosius 5 metus
sources.said: leidimu laikinai gyventi arba Europos Sąjungos valstybės narės piliečio šeimos nario leidimo gyventi kortele ar nacionaline viza – galite kreiptis dėl leidimo nuolat gyventi. ... per 3 mėnesius ... 220,00 Eur ... Dėl leidimo nuolat gyventi išdavimo turite asmeniškai kreiptis per 4 mėnesius nuo prašymo per MIGRIS užpildymo dienos ... Migracijos departamento teritoriniam skyriui pateikti nereikia
